title: Explain Two Plans for an Outdoor Event

source.rights: 项目原创虚构教学材料；AI 编写并对照教学规则、原文和题目证据复核。
source.reviewScope: Ordinary A2 practice. Exact source contexts and answers reviewed; synthetic en-US audio checked for file integrity, decoding, role/segment alignment and unprompted ASR content. Pronunciation and intonation are not independently certified.

instructions: Write your own first draft and submit it for feedback.
prompt: Write 120–160 words to a friend about an outdoor event. Describe the expected weather and any visible evidence, predict what might happen, and explain what you will do if conditions change. Use at least six lesson words and include two if + present, will sentences.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Plan four parts: event and place; forecast and visible signs; a clear condition and outdoor plan; a different condition and indoor plan. Check that if clauses use the present form.
